elTapir.intro: South America’s second-largest wilderness after the Amazon, home to the jaguar, the tapir and the giant anteater, and to our first Remote Rancher herd. Not a partner ranch: ours. It’s growing, and open to visitors by appointment.

ganaderiaAPasto.body: How we grow supply. Ganadería a Pasto is the group’s technical arm: people in the field, helping ranches move to cattle raised on grass.
